title: SpecificationDoc
description: Specification of a plan: the canonical document of a draft and the payload of a published revision. References between entities use display keys; identity is the uuid 'id'. Numbers are integers only (canonical JSON v1 forbids floats).

uuid.description: Stable entity id (UUIDv7, lowercase). Optional in a draft: SaveDraft assigns it.

date.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (historical date without time).

item_key.description: Item display key, e.g. P1.2; the prefix is its phase key.

unit_key.description: Unit display key, e.g. P1.2/U1; the prefix is its item key.

unit_ref.description: Unit reference: local U<k> (inside the owning item) or full P<n>.<m>/U<k>.

check_local_key.description: Check key unique within its owner (phase or item).

check_ref.description: Check reference: V<n> (owner implied by context) or <owner key>:V<n>.

entity_ref.description: Reference to a phase, item, unit, decision, requirement or criterion of this plan.

mount.description: Repository mount name of the project (project_repositories.mount_name).

repo_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path; no leading '/', '~', drive letter or '..' segment.

path_glob.description: Repository-relative POSIX path or fnmatch glob (*, ?, [..]); a trailing '/' names a directory.

plan_ref.description: Another plan of the same project: short alias <prefix><n> (prefix from planning.aliases.prefix, default PLAN; never AC) or plan:<uuid>.

section.description: Named content section; ids unique within the owning entity.

scope.description: Scope in words: what is in and out.

effort.description: Ordered low < medium < high < xhigh < max (legacy 'ultra' is imported as 'max').

runtime.description: Preferred runtime id (validated against the catalog; a preference, never a requirement).

correction.description: Minimum route of a bounded correction round.

route.description: Minimum semantic route of the work.

review.description: Explicit review contract. Absence of the field is not a waiver.

research.description: Research need (status is execution state, not specification).

read.description: One input to read, in reading order.

change_hint.description: Files likely to change (a hint, not a write limit).

write_scope_entry.description: Declared write scope entry of a unit (a limit enforced by the worker fence).

artifact_decl.description: Artifact consumed or produced; an output with a key may be read as artifact/<key>.

check.description: Verification of work: command, shell, manual or external.

owner.description: Phase or item that owns the check.

category.description: acceptance must pass for done; impact is a wider guard; live runs at a live boundary.

required.description: Default: true for acceptance, false otherwise (resolved by from_document, stored explicitly).

unit_command.description: Exact command of a command unit.

brief.description: Owner brief: what was asked, by whom, in which words.

batch.description: Ordered execution group inside a phase; an item is in at most one batch.

depends_on.description: Prerequisite phases. Absent: the previous phase in order. Empty: none.

checks.description: Checks of the owning item that gate this unit.

material.description: Material bound to the revision: a pinned file version, a repository path or an external source. Freshness defaults to pinned (written explicitly by normalization).

required_for.description: Stages that cannot proceed without this material (empty or absent: optional reference). execution: blocks task start; review: blocks review rounds; acceptance: blocks the acceptance decision. Unavailable at that stage -> execution waits with BLOCKED_BY_MATERIAL.

oneOf.description: Use exactly the pinned version (file_version), the run baseline commit (repository_path) or the captured content (external_source).
At publication the newest ready version of the same file is pinned and written into the revision; afterwards behaves as pinned.
Pinned, but older than max_age_seconds (file version created_at / retrieved_at) counts as stale: a stage it is required for waits with BLOCKED_BY_MATERIAL until a revision pins a fresher one.

freshness.description: Use exactly the pinned version (file_version), the run baseline commit (repository_path) or the captured content (external_source).

max_parallel_units.description: Upper bound that is part of the plan's meaning; the run uses min(this, execution.parallel.max_units).

execution_constraints.description: Constraints that belong to the plan's meaning and are frozen with the revision (not configuration).

extensions.description: Namespaced extension payloads (namespace 'publisher/name' -> {schema_version, value}). Unknown core fields are never accepted here.

work_policy.description: Partial task work policy; absent members inherit settings -> item -> unit. Not a settings scope or authority override.
